propositions: When an author fixes a single named instance instead of the entire population it samples from, reviewers give instance-level feedback across multiple passes without signaling the enumeration method is faulty.

Plan-review move 15 must reframe a named instance as a population sample and require a machine-checkable completeness proof via grep or similar, scoped via applies_when to criteria G1G2/E4/G6/A1 where populations exist.

Move 15's template must contain exactly one {subject} placeholder and the exact text: 'Treat {subject} as one sample from a population, not a single item to fix — enumerate the whole population by the distinct ways the pattern occurs, then add a machine-checkable acceptance criterion that fails while any instance remains.'
The new move entry is addition-only; no existing move ids, names, templates, or applies_when conditions change.
Move 15 is inapplicable without its four declared triggers and applicable for each trigger individually via the kernel's move_applies mechanism.
The docs/plan-review-gate.md move table must mirror the new registry entry with matching id 15, name, and template.
